title: A five-strip covering certificate for planar null geodesics in an equal-mass Majumdar-Papapetrou spacetime
description: Article, two saved interval certificates and offline finite checks for five strip coverings in a planar null-geodesic return map. The entropy bound is per return. Checks assume the original validated-flow enclosures. Lean L0; no human peer review. Code Apache-2.0, original text and generated data CC BY 4.0.
